office_does: A Court of Appeals judge reviews appeals from superior-court cases in Eastern Washington; District 1 judges are elected for six-year terms by voters in Ferry, Lincoln, Okanogan, Pend Oreille, Spokane and Stevens counties.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Tracy Arlene Staab, who won the seat in 2020, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals judge (Division III, District 1) elected in 2020, previously a Spokane Municipal Court judge (2009-2020) and federal appellate defender; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Won this seat in 2020 with 62.84% of the district vote [S3]
Spokane Municipal Court judge from 2009 and earlier a Court of Appeals law clerk and federal appellate defense attorney [S2]
Submitted no statement to the 2026 voters' guide [S1]
